notes.title: Planetbase 2 - Dev Update 01
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We've recently announced that we've started work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509420/Planetbase_2/]Planetbase 2[/url]. The response has been great, people seem to be as excited about the project as we are, we thank you all for that!

We are now hard at work to make sure the game delivers according to everyone's expectations.

We are actually [i]coding the game from scratch[/i] (as we did for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858810/Dawn_of_Man/]Dawn of Man[/url]) as the code for Planetbase 1 is very old and it's just better to start over.

We've added a ton of stuff so far, but these are some of the highlights:


[h2]New Astronaut models[/h2]

We've updated the Astronauts with a more modern look and with more real proportions, a bit more like the characters in Dawn of Man.
Models can be [i]tinted[/i] with various colors for the different [i]specializations[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/923ff27db3f0a15fa5f607a925f4886a5cdc9c41.png[/img]
We've posted more details about this on [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks]social media[/url] if you are interested: 
[url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1920066429254054209]Video[/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1918202661544829430]Concept [/url]- [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1925155543800336653]PB1 Comparison[/url].


[h2]Vehicles[/h2]

We have various [b]vehicles [/b]in the game. They allow colonists to [i]carry more resources[/i] and [i]reach locations[/i] further from the base.
You can also build [b]roads[/b], which make vehicles a lot [b]faster[/b].

Colonists automatically pick up vehicles when needed, but you can also manually tell them to do so, and tell them where to drive the vehicle.
We are also working on specialized mining and tanker vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/b6d9dc449426ed2e7d405d2654fe85a7d24f686f.png[/img]
More details:
[url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1928406174539399670]Video [/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1927332585681633692]High Poly[/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1912403672119529748]Pathfinding[/url]


[h2]Nuclear Power[/h2]

We have the complete nuclear power mechanics in the game.
- There is a [b]Nuclear Reactor[/b] structure, that needs to be fed [b]Nuclear Fuel[/b].
- They need to be monitored from the [b]Nuclear Console[/b] in the [b]Control Center[/b] (like Telescopes in PB1).
- They produce [b]Nuclear Waste[/b], that has to be taken to the [b]Nuclear Dump[/b].
- The [b]Landing Ship[/b] will have a nuclear reactor inside, which will provide initial power for the colony.
- We will still have [b]Solar Panels[/b] and [b]Wind Turbines[/b], nuclear power will be an alternative that will work well in certain situations.

See the [b]Nuclear Reactor[/b] (available in 3 sizes) and [b]Nuclear Dump[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/fd691335646f96c3df5873a982ae917706e94ddd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/2f051557f4c4a94cd3a05bdd3a66856adea76cdc.png[/img]


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

We are also working on other stuff, like the [b]Tech Tree[/b], [b]Work Areas[/b], [b]Mining [/b]and even [b]Toilets[/b]!

We intend to post updates every 2-3 months here, but if you want to stay more up to date with the development you can follow us on [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks]X[/url] or [url=https://madrugaworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], we post several times a week there.

Let us know what you think!

Martiño.
